since.description: TASK-28. When this Task's condition began. It is what a stuck Task is read from: one open since Tuesday is one nobody has answered, and it is the field ALRT-3 puts on an Alert, read the same way. It replaced counts of Claims that had failed and lapsed, and says less: how long a condition has held, and nothing about what anybody did about it.
